content: पिञ्जर {%a.%} [पिञ्ज्-अरच्] Reddish-yellow, tawny, gold-coloured; शिखा प्रदीपस्य सुवर्णपिञ्जरा <ls>Mk. 3. 17</ls>; <ls>R. 18. 40</ls>. .{@-रः@} .²1 The reddish-yellow or tawny-brown colour. .²2 The yellow colour; नभो नैरन्तर्यप्रचलिततडित्पिञ्जरमिव <ls>Mv. 1. 43</ls>. .{@-रम्@} .²1 Gold. .²2 Yellow orpiment. .²3 A skeleton. .²4 Cage (for पञ्जर). .²5 The ribs or the cavity formed by them, the thorax.
